title: An editor signs in to the newsroom with Google
description:
Google sign-in is the only way in.

```gherkin
Feature: Newsroom sign-in

  Scenario: An invited editor signs in
    Given an editor who has been added to the editors group
    When they sign in with Google
    Then they reach the newsroom

  Scenario: There is no password form
    Given the sign-in page
    Then it offers Google sign-in only
```
